rows.text: Leash is la correa. Can you say la correa?
A tree is el árbol in Spanish. Try saying it.
Auf Spanisch heißt das el árbol. Versuch es.
In Portuguese, the tree is a árvore. Repeat it.
You can say a coleira. Try saying it.
Du kannst es versuchen. Ich warte auf dich.
The brown dog runs along the path.
